tokenCost.description: Total tokens for the call. Remains required. inputTokens + outputTokens is not required to equal tokenCost; providers report differently. (RFC 012)

inputTokens.description: Prompt tokens for the call, when the provider reports the split. (RFC 012)

outputTokens.description: Completion tokens for the call, when the provider reports the split. (RFC 012)

modelId.description: Provider model identifier the call was served by; the same tokenCost costs an order of magnitude apart across models, so accounting needs this to be meaningful. (RFC 012)

provider.description: Serving provider (for example vertex, bedrock, openai). (RFC 012)

modelTier.description: Routing tier actually used, matching ModelRoutingPolicy.defaultTier; eval scores are not comparable across tiers without it. (RFC 012)

spendUsd.description: Provider-reported billable amount for this call, not a normalized cross-provider estimate. Aggregates into UsageMeter.externalSpendUsd and is enforced against BudgetPolicy.maxSpendUsd. (RFC 012)

uncertainty.description: Per-call uncertainty or confidence hints; GAP-002 dispositions Uncertainty onto eval and reasoning payloads, and this adds the missing carrier on tool.call. (RFC 012)

attemptId.description: ExecutionAttempt.attemptId of the attempt this call was made under, when the Run executes through an external task system. The journal.* counterpart is payload.details.attemptId. (RFC 022)
